body:
maria_csm: @orchid_ops quick sync — Orchid Finance asked for a short pilot: they need a temporary QPS bump for their Canada private deployment tomorrow morning, ~2x for ~2 hours. also want a custom header allowed through the edge (their proxy uses a header). opening ticket CS-4123.
orchid_ops: thanks @maria_csm — confirming: start 08:00 PST tomorrow, duration 2h, target ~120 rps. will DM exact header name and source CIDRs.
akash_infra: can enable but need explicit header name + CIDR list and whether this should auto-revoke. tagging @jamie_sre for SLA/latency watch.
maria_csm: they confirmed header has no PII and will auto-revoke request after window. renewal risk flagged if the pilot fails, so want us to treat as priority.
jamie_sre: ok — monitoring rules: trigger if p50 > 120ms or error_rate > 1%. suggest canary route + fallback to eu region if saturating.
akash_infra: I can push a temporary policy. will schedule auto-revoke. need precise values for qps/burst — is 200 qps per-route enough?
orchid_ops: 200 qps works. CIDRs: 35.182.10.0/24, 35.182.11.0/24. header: X-Orchid-Auth.
maria_csm: added those to CS-4123. @akash_infra add auto-revoke at 10:00 PST please.
akash_infra: auto-revoke scheduled for 10:00 PST. pushing to staging canary now. config snippet below for records:
```yaml
route: /v1/orchid/*
allow_headers:
  - X-Orchid-Auth
cidr_allowlist:
  - 35.182.10.0/24
  - 35.182.11.0/24
qps:
  default: 100
  temporary_override:
    value: 200
    window: 2h
```
deploy-bot: config push to canary-edge-tn1 succeeded (cfg-78a1) — rollback window: 15m.
jamie_sre: I'll watch tail latency and error budget during the window. will open incident if thresholds hit.
maria_csm: perfect — I'll confirm schedule with Orchid and note renewal impact in the ticket. thanks team :tada:
orchid_ops: appreciated. we'll run the pilot and report back in this thread. thanks everyone!
